nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

avis.titre: MOLDY and INEFFECTIVE - product goes bad quickly
avis.texte: Purchased this less than a year ago. I don't wear makeup all the time so this large tub lasts a while. When I went to use it last night, I discovered that the product was covered in mold! I've also found that I need to use it at least twice followed by a regular cleanser to get eye makeup off completely. Overall, the product doesn't work that well and goes bad very quickly.

This is the best makeup remover I have ever used!!! It instantly melts makeup away, is soft on skin, and the holy grail for sensitive/irritable skin! I have used many other brands and this is by far the best. I never leave reviews but had to for this product, it's that good!!! Every makeup remover I have tried before this has irritated my eyes and causes them to swell up but this product doesnt do that!!!
Removes makeup and sunscreen easily without any irritation. It takes off mascara with no issues and doesn't burn my eyes. Works really well—so glad I found it!

I have purchased this so many times and it's definitely one of my faves! It goes on so smooth and rinses off easily. I use it to take off my make up and follow up with my cleanser. It feels greasy but it's really not! Works great and feels good on my skin!

avis.titre: My new go to makeup remover!
avis.texte: This is my new go to makeup remover. I've seen others use it and always wanted to try it. I decided to try it when there were mini sizes on sale. I'm glad it did because I love it. A little goes a long way and makes taking off your makeup feel so nice and luxurious. It is great at taking off all my makeup, including mascara, and it leaves my skin feeling very moisturized and nice looking. I recommend.

I ordered this product from Ulta expecting a new, unused item. Unfortunately, the product I received had already been used, and the bottle was clearly marked as a tester. Be sure to inspect your order carefully before using any products you receive!!
I love so much the clinique balm. This is the best on my opinion for any type of skin. I always buy it. I have been using for over 3 years. I will buy again.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: I purchased this 5 weeks ago and the product is growing mold. I returned the product. I am very concerned about what I had been putting on my face.

I would recommend this to every single person in the world if I could. It truly takes off everything: waterproof makeup, glitter and more. I'm on my third purchase of this product. I really need them to never change the formula. Because if they do I'll cry.
This is a great product to use for removing makeup. Great on skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again.
avis.texte: Melts makeup right off and didn't irritate my eyes or leave me feeling dry.
I've never found anything as nice as this to take off my makeup and cleanse my skin with no harsh chemicals or rubbing or burning. I love this !!

avis.titre: Yes I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I've used Clinique products for years. I love all my purchases.
I love how my skin is so soft after using. I received a sample with a purchase and had to get more. Thanks Ulta.
"This makeup remover was disappointing. It struggled to remove waterproof mascara and required a lot of rubbing. For the price, I expected much better performance. I wouldn't purchase it again."
I was surprised that this product works as well as it does and is gentle on the skin. Also, it leaves the skin clean and moisturized.
I received a sample of this at the store & loved it so much I bought it when my sample ran out. Because it's a solid I can take it through security at the airport.

I did not know that this would be a solid cleanser similar to a chapstick that will melt into an oil with the heat of the skin. It works so far and I am getting use to it. I have the largest jar and the travel size. I would purchase it again. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: A great product. Really melts your make up away.
avis.texte: Works very well. And it's so easy to use. Just one time cleans away all your make up. Also great value for money.
I have been using this product for years. I love the way it makes my skin feel and wouldn't be without it.

avis.titre: A great product. Really melts your make up away.
avis.texte: Works very well. And it's so easy to use. Just one time cleans away all your make up. Also great value for money.

I love this stuff, it's moisturizing and cleansing at the same time. It feels good to rub it into your skin knowing it will remove all traces of make-up in your pores, and leave your skin soft and clean, not tight. I use it religiously.
I love this cleansing removal balm it can be used alone or in a two step process. It is thick, cleansing and my skin feels nourished and makeup free
I have been using this product for years. I love the way it makes my skin feel and wouldn't be without it.

avis.titre: Definitely a great product, and I would highly recommend it!
avis.texte: This cleansing balm is amazing! It melts away all my makeup and impurities so easily. Even stubborn makeup just dissolves without any effort. After using it, my skin feels very clean, soft, and fresh without any dryness or tight feeling

I just used Clinic's take the day off for the very first time and I must admit I was skeptical at first, but after I got done cleaning my face and patting it dry. I was very surprised and excited that I finally found something that cleans my face better than the way I was doing it before I highly recommend this. I got the big jar so it will last me a long time. It is awesome.
It literally melts your makeup. I love that it leaves my skin clean and now is easier to remove the mascara and foundation with one product. Recommend!!!

This is my go-to makeup remover. I have repurchased several times and will continue to do so. The makeup melts off, and you don't have to use much. I wear makeup almost every day, and the large jar lasts me at least 6 months.

a little goes a VERY long way- i do a soft glam look everyday and this lasted me about 5 months. def worth the money. ive tried cheaper cleansing balms but they dont work the way this one does. be careful near your eyes it blurs ur vision till u wash it off fully.

I was shown about this product when I went inside Ulta Beauty for a foundation match. I was totally surprised at how it took off the foundation without any itchiness. I immediately bought this balm when I got home. Prior to this, I used a drugstore wipe brand and could feel the aftermath it left on my face. This one completely wipes off all of my makeup without the itch and makes my face feel super clean.

avis.titre: Didn't remove makeup but DID mess up my contact lenses
avis.texte: I wanted to like this (so much so that I ordered two of the largest jars offered). But it barely made a dent in the Clinique waterproof mascara (even after desperate rubbing after trying gentle wipes). What if DID do was make a mess of my 30 day contacts so that I have to remove them and soak them after I've washed my face. I was definitely NOT looking to add that extra step, time, or effort to my nightly routine. I will be returning these and I would NOT recommend it for contact lense wearers.
This is an excellent makeup remover. It does the trick and leaves skin moisturized.

I only wear mascara on a daily basis & this takes it off easy. I use it in the shower to remove my mascara & I just need a small finger nail worth & removes it without pulling my eyelashes. I've been using this for years and I've never used any other makeup remover since. I love that it's also in a balm form so it's easy to travel with & don't have to worry about liquid spilling.
"Take the Day Off" is the best makeup remover I have ever found.
I bought the little travel size first to make sure it melted my makeup off, which it did. So I bought the large size once I got a discount coupon. It's my favorite cleansing/makeup remover!
This is a staple product for me. Best make up remover on the market.

avis.titre: only cleansing balm i will ever use
avis.texte: very gentle abs a little goes a long way. In my opinion, clinique has the best makeuo removers on the market incouding their eye makeup remover. suoer great product!

I purchased this cleanser because I like Clinique, but I was amazed when I used it. WOW, it cleans so well and made my skin feel incredible. Not dry yet really clean. One of my favorites and a new staple in my home.

I was looking for a good mascara remover, and Jessica in Hanford, CA helped me. She was very kind and took the time to explain the product to me. She won me over right away. I really appreciated how she approached me, no pressure, no hesitation, she simply asked if I needed help. I told her what I was looking for, and she delivered exactly that.
This is by far my favorite cleansing balm. It pulls off even mascara, eyeliner and lipstick, so you can slather it all over your face ‼️ It gets the job done‼️
I really like this product, it's a good alternative to double cleanse with! However, using it on the eye area really makes your vision blurry.

avis.titre: Takes stubborn makeup off and great for oily skin
avis.texte: I have oily skin and I dislike the feeling of greesiness. This cleasing balm is amazing as it completely dissolves the makeup and sunscreen, while leaving my skin feeling very clean. Does not feel greesy on my skin! This is my second time purchasing a big tub. It lasts a long time.

It doesnt remove mascara or lipstick. For something so expensive you would think it would work. This stuff doesn't even break down mascara or lipstick. It smears mascara around and gives you raccoon eyes, even after rinsing. I do love raccoons but I would prefer to not be one. I really dont see the hype sadly.
Love this! Its the only make up remover iv tried that i feel like genuinly removes all of my mascara.

I use this balm as step 2 of my makeup removal process primarily for my face makeup and eyebrows. I use the liquid take the day off for my eyes and lips. I've tried many other brands but went back to this. Solid 10 for my mature skin

I got this for the purpose of removing makeup. I use a lancome waterproof mascara, and this didn't even begin to break it down. It also really blurred my vision and it took a lot of rinsing with micellar water and washing my face to get the blurriness to go away. I already have sensitive and dry eyes, I didn't need all that extra nonsense thrown on top - for $44, absolutely not worth it. I've used other (cheaper) cleansing balms that don't cloud my vision. Will be returning, sadly.
I use this daiky & love it. It's so smooth & silky, doesn't leave your face oily. A little goes a long way. I use a towelette with warm water, softer on my skin than a towel. Highly recommend.
Melts off your makeup so easily. Also great for morning double cleanse
Love how this melts on your skin, making it go farther. The only thing I wish was different is the size. Sometimes I am short on cash and would like to find a smaller size.

avis.titre: I really wanted to like this product
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product. Its very messy once it melts on the skin. It does have a slight odor but its hardly noticeable. It works well for foundation but struggled to take my mascara off (not waterproof) along with my eyebrow pencil. Still needed a makeuo wipe after using. And it foes cloud vision for some time it used around the eye area.

This product has changed the way I remove makeup! I've always used inexpensive makesup wipes but after using this makeup remover balm I can't go back. For starters, this balm is worth every penny, it's extremely refreshing and gentle, helps ALL your makeup completely melt off, prepares your skin for cleansing, and feels amazing!!!!

I have very sensitive skin and almost everything makes my face break out but this stuff doesn't. It's so sensitive there is literally 1 moisturizer I can uses that my face doesn't have a reaction to. I leave it in the shower and when I shower at night I use it to remove my makeup and then wash my face. I have been using this stuff for years and nothing compares to it.
All I can say is this: Clinique Take the Day Off cleansing balm and makeup remover is bar none the best makeup remover I've ever used.

Ive been using this product for a long time. I use waterproof mascara and this product takes everything off. You have to apply the product on your face without water at first, thats how you will get rid of the makeup and after rubbing it all over your face thats when you rinse off.

Never noticed any unpleasant sent. It does all promised and more. It hydrates my skin. I always follow with gentle facial Clinique soap. I am always told i look 20 years younger than i am. I have always used Clinique products.
I absolutely love this stuff!! It is a complete life changer for my eyes. I have had such a hard time finding eye makeup remover that doesn't hurt my eyes/eye lashes.

I would only recommend this for dry skin. The secret: rub it between your fingers, then massage it thoroughly (not spread it) onto dry skin. Then take it off with a washcloth and A LOT of warm water. If you wipe it off like a cleansing cream, it will leave a lot behind.. Massaging and rinsing left my skin very soft. Love this!

I decided to try the balm first. It is great on makeup removal, however it is a little greasy. I mainly use it to remove eye makeup and my mascara. It only takes a small amount as it spreads easily. I may be trying the makeup remover instead to compare.
This is a holy grail for me. It takes off all my makeup and leaves my skin soft.

at removing makeup, even liner and mascara without stinging or burning. This is the ONLY product I've ever used that doesn't do that. It rinses clean and makes your skin feel like velvet. I use this first, rinse, then wash with Clinique facial cleanser. I then use my facial treatments for the night. *I use it even if I don't have makeup on.*

avis.titre: They should call this "Melt the day away"...
avis.texte: All time favorite makeup remover, or "melter" before washing my face. It is not harsh and it loosens up even the strongest finishing spray I've used. It leaves me feeling hydrated and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. I have dry skin and I absolutely love this!

I was looking for a new makeup remover and this was not it. I just had a little mascara and it left a film in my eyes and burned all around my eyes. Now I have watery, red puffy eyes. It also didn't do a great job compared to my oil based remover
This stuff just melts your makeup off. Does not feel greasy when you are done, just feels clean. I love this!
This balm effortlessly melts makeup off no matter how much product you have on. Very effective and easy to use. Has not stripped my skin or given me any reactions either.

This did absolutely nothing for me. It didnt break down or take off my makeup or mascara as i wouldve expected. Still had to use my makeup remover wipes because this balm just made more of mess if anything. Honestly, this was a waste of money for me.
My face is clearer than ever because this actually removes all my make-up!
I bought this for traveling since it is a small size. It worked well on a sunburned face without drying.

avis.titre: Love this cleansing balm as much as the one I paid $200 more
avis.texte: I actually look forward to my evening ritual now that I have Clinique's Cleansing Balm! I loved my other designer one, but just couldn't justify the cost.This balm is relaxing, does an amazing job, and feels so good on my sensitive skin, it is beautiful!

avis.titre: I have bought this product over and over again
avis.texte: It takes off all my makeup. Even waterproof mascara! It does not leave a sticky or oily residue. I am hooked.
Love having this cleanser in a small size to take on vacation. Feels great on my skin. Takes off all makeup.
I really was enjoying this product but the last time I opened the container it had two dark areas that look like mold. I had the jar closed tightly so I'm not sure how this happened.
This is the only makeup remover that doesn't bother my eyes. It's not drying and it removes all my heavy makeup including waterproof mascara with ease.
I have this cleansing balm for a while and I love it. I have tried other brands and irritates my eyes. I would definitely keep buying it

I received this cleansing balm as a free birthday gift from Clinique. I had never used a cleansing balm before and was skeptical during the first application due to the balm's texture. However, I quickly learned how to use the product. I love the way it feels on my face during cleansing! So soft and smooth! After rubbing the balm around my face, I follow with a warm rinse and then my facial cleanser. My aging skin has never looked better. Thank you for the birthday gift, Clinique!
this balm is the best 👌, gentle on and around the eyes, soft , Remove everything: spf, make up, sweat . Ive tried others nothing compares
Love a cleansing balm but number one this isn't super effective on mascara like other balms and it smells like rancid oil. Such an unpleasant experience.
I have been using this balm for many years. My skin is never irritated and is always soft. I even use it to remove waterproof mascara- no tugging or teary eyes.
This works so well. Takes off ALL the makeup easily and doesn't make my skin feel dry after.
Love how easy it is to use Put it on and get in shower and leaves my face very clean

Make up removal never felt so good. I used to not like wearing make up because I found it difficult to remove and removers left my skin feeling icky and burned my eyes. But this cream goes on dry (it truly is silky like they say) and washes off everything in its wake. It's a lovely way to take care of my skin and start winding down for the night.

avis.titre: Clinique Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I will never use anything else but Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm. It leaves my skin hydrated and very clean. It is well worth the price. I have used many cleansers before that left my skin dry and itchy. Well done Clinique such a great product
This takes off my mascara with ease. And I don't need to use a lot

I had perfect skin and 1 month ago I decided to try this product to help take off my makeup. I started to notice some small whiteheads at first and didn't think much of it. But now im battling full on cystic acne and big pimples all over my face aswell as the small whiteheads. The texture is weird too. This literally ruined my skin in one month!!! Nothing else had changed in my rutine except this. Stay away please.

avis.titre: Initially Skeptical but love it now
avis.texte: I got this as a free gift from Clinique and initially did not know how to use it, left my face sticky and needing soap to wash it off. This was a user error, I youtubed how to use it and now love it. Takes off all the makeup and does not even need soap to wash it off. All it needs is patience to wash your face with warm water a few times (2-3). Skin feels smooth and it even works on eye makeup. This is the first ever makeup remover than works both on face and eyes, prevously I had to use two separate products.
Clinique still has great stuff, unfortunately this product isn't great. It actually takes work to get the makeup off and after it takes even more work to get this off.
Clinique still has great stuff, unfortunately this product isn't great. It actually takes work to get the makeup off and after it takes even more work to get this off.
I use the cleansing balm as my first cleanse. The texture is silky and it makes cleansing a very pleasant experience. After rinsing, my skin showed no traces of dirt or makeup.
The best cleansing balm on the market hands down! I will forever repurchase.

This is now a staple in my routine. I use to melt my makeup off before washing my face. Feels great on my skin and you don't need a lot to remove a full face of makeup, including mascara. I got the gift set so the large jar goes in my bathroom and the travel size goes in my toiletries bag so I always have some!

I love this product! I was utterly amazed by how well it removed makeup, even waterproof mascara and extended wear lipstick but I was beyond amazed that it rinsed with just warm water so easily and left my skin feeling clean not at all oily or with any residue! Seriously, this stuff is magic.
It's the best to use before face wash. It removes makeup and any residue. My face feels clean.
Seamlessly removes makeup while leaving your skin hydrated and soft.

I wanted to like this as I love Clinique products. I bought it during the Ulta 21 Days of Beauty, so it was super affordable. It does work at getting makeup off, but the product smells like old cardboard or newspaper. I'm wondering if I received an old/expired one. Because of this, I'll be trying another cleanser next.
While it does remove eye makeup, I had to return it because it gave me styes. It's so thick and greasy that it clogged my eye glands
I use this along with the 7 day scrub for double cleansing and it really cleans my skin. Removes make up and sunscreen.
I absolutely love this cleansing balm! It removes everything quickly. You won't regret this purchase!

I'm really confused by the 5-star reviews. I was sent this product as a free birthday promotion. It smells like rancid Crisco and acts the same as well. To get this off from my skin, I am forced to use a soap then rinse, then soap up again and rinse (sometimes three times). Did someone return this product after emptying and keeping the contents, filling it with Crisco and sending it back to Clinique?

avis.titre: LOVE this!  Best makeup remover ever!
avis.texte: This is the best makeup remover I've ever used. It easily removes water resistant full coverage foundation and waterproof makeup, lipstick, etc. After I rub the product around my face (sometimes add a little warm water to the mix), I then run a clean washcloth under warm water to wipe everything off. I have sensitive skin and prone to breakouts with certain products. This product doesn't cause breakouts and my skin feels hydrated and silky smooth when I'm done.

Does a great job at melting down the makeup. My skin seems to be clearing up, less blemishes than before and i really think its because of this stuff! I try to avoid using on my eye makeup unless im wearing heavy eyeliner or eyeshadow as it can make my vision a bit blurry. Other than that, i love it!

Does a great job at melting down the makeup. My skin seems to be clearing up, less blemishes than before and i really think its because of this stuff! I try to avoid using on my eye makeup unless im wearing heavy eyeliner or eyeshadow as it can make my vision a bit blurry. Other than that, i love it!

Does a great job at melting down the makeup. My skin seems to be clearing up, less blemishes than before and i really think its because of this stuff! I try to avoid using on my eye makeup unless im wearing heavy eyeliner or eyeshadow as it can make my vision a bit blurry. Other than that, i love it!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again !!
avis.texte: I love this product.It feels great on my skin and works great .
This is the best makeup remover I have ever tried. Great for double cleaning before your face wash.
I have used other brands and the mascara doesn't clean well, but this product is great! No matter if I apply the matte long wear lipstick, this makeup removal does the trick 🤩
